title: Traditional Turkish Kazandibi
description: A classic Turkish dessert made with milk, sugar, and a touch of lemon.
instructions: Boil the quenched milk in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sugar and stir until it dissolves.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the Turkish kazandibi cream and stir until well combined.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the lemon juice and salt.
Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Chill the mixture in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Serve the kazandibi cold, garnished with a sprinkle of sugar if desired.
